label: Aquinas contrasts the innocent and righteous with sinners, appeals to the common good, and argues…
paraphrase: Aquinas contrasts the innocent and righteous with sinners, appeals to the common good, and argues it is unlawful to slay the innocent, but in reply to the Abraham objection treats killing at a divine command as non-sinful; the relation between these passages and claims of an exceptionless prohibition requires interpretation.
